prompts.label: organoidagent_architecture
prompts.prompt: Create a publication-quality clean scientific workflow diagram on a white background. Show an end-to-end pipeline for organoid analysis with five connected modules: Dataset Intake, Type-aware Preview Engine, Single-cell Embedding Summary, Archive Extraction, and Interactive Web Report. Use modern flat vector style, soft blue and gray palette, rounded rectangles, clean arrows, subtle shadows. Add tiny icon-like glyphs only (folder, image, table, scatter plot), but no text labels anywhere in the image. Keep composition balanced and suitable for Nature-style figure panels.

prompts.label: quality_control_examples
prompts.prompt: Create a four-panel scientific figure layout on white background showing brightfield organoid quality control examples. Panel 1: sharp in-focus organoid edge. Panel 2: defocus blur artifact. Panel 3: uneven illumination vignette. Panel 4: debris contamination particles. Add red and green overlay masks and simple confidence bars, but no text characters. Make it realistic, clean, and publication-ready.

prompts.label: segmentation_tracking_overlay
prompts.prompt: Create a scientific visualization panel showing organoid boundary segmentation and immune-cell trajectory tracking over time. Use grayscale microscopy-like background with a central organoid outlined in cyan contour. Overlay multiple smooth colored trajectories with arrowheads, start/end dots, and small track IDs represented as geometric symbols only, no text characters. Include a compact inset showing matching/association matrix as colored squares without numbers. Publication quality, clean and high contrast.

prompts.label: growth_forecasting_curve
prompts.prompt: Create a publication-style forecasting result figure on white background. Show two line-chart style curves (observed vs predicted organoid growth) with confidence ribbons, plus a small residual distribution inset and a calibration scatter inset. Use blue/orange color coding, precise grid lines, minimalistic scientific styling. Do not include any text, numbers, or axis labels.
